title: Security Access Policy
body: All employees must use MFA for sensitive systems. Access reviews are required quarterly. Encryption is mandatory for confidential exports. Contact security@veloxsdemo.com for exceptions.

title: Data Encryption Standard
body: Confidential data must be encrypted at rest and in transit using approved algorithms. TLS 1.2 or higher is required for all access to internal systems. Keys are rotated annually.

title: Account Access Review Procedure
body: Access to customer accounts follows least privilege. Quarterly access reviews remove stale permissions. Privileged access requires manager approval and is logged for audit.

title: Invoice Handling Procedure
body: Invoices must be reviewed before payment. Revenue-impacting adjustments require finance approval. Send invoice questions to ap@veloxsdemo.com by the monthly close date.

title: Payment and Refund Policy
body: Customer payments are reconciled weekly. Refunds above the threshold require finance approval. Disputed invoices are escalated to the revenue team within two business days.

title: Customer Support SLA
body: Support requests receive a first response within four business hours. Renewal and account questions are routed to customer success. Critical issues are escalated to on-call support.
